svg.aria-label: Chronology: capability milestones and later legal steps
svg.title: Chronology: capability milestones and later legal steps
svg.desc: Hexagon: capability milestone. Circle: treaty. Square: resolution or body finding (non-binding). Triangle: unilateral pledge. Open ring: no binding rule yet. Chronology only: a pair shows which came first, not causation.
svg.text: Chronology: capability milestones and later legal steps
Data as of SWF 9th ed. (Apr. 2026) · Source: SWF 2026 and ledger

svg.desc: Dumbbell chart: for each pair, a hexagon marks the capability milestone and a shape marks the later legal or policy step (circle for treaty, square for a resolution or body finding, triangle for a unilateral pledge). The gap is the elapsed time in years, shown as chronology, not causation. An open ring means no binding rule yet.

g.aria-label: Bold Orion missile flyby (1959), then the Outer Space Treaty (1967), which bans nuclear weapons in orbit and is silent on conventional ASATs. 7.3 years.
g.text: Bold Orion missile flyby (1959), then the Outer Space Treaty (1967), which bans nuclear weapons in orbit and is silent on conventional ASATs

g.aria-label: Starfish Prime (1962), then the Limited Test Ban Treaty (1963), which followed it. 1.1 years.
g.text: Starfish Prime (1962), then the Limited Test Ban Treaty (1963), which followed it

g.aria-label: Fengyun-1C destructive test (2007), then UNGA 77/41 (2022), a non-binding call not to conduct destructive tests. 15.9 years.
g.text: Fengyun-1C destructive test (2007), then UNGA 77/41 (2022), a non-binding call not to conduct destructive tests

g.aria-label: Cosmos 1408 destructive test (2021), then a US test moratorium (2022, unilateral pledge). 5 months.
g.text: Cosmos 1408 destructive test (2021), then a US test moratorium (2022, unilateral pledge)

g.aria-label: Baltic-region GNSS interference (from 2023), then an ICAO Assembly finding on recurring GNSS interference (2025). 1.8 years.
g.text: Baltic-region GNSS interference (from 2023), then an ICAO Assembly finding on recurring GNSS interference (2025)

g.aria-label: Jamming of European satellites (2024), then ITU RRB “grave concern” (2024). 4 months.
g.text: Jamming of European satellites (2024), then ITU RRB “grave concern” (2024)

g.aria-label: Laser fired at a satellite (1997): no specific rule on lasers against satellites. No binding response yet.
g.text: Laser fired at a satellite (1997): no specific rule on lasers against satellites

g.aria-label: Viasat cyberattack (2022): attributions only; Tallinn 2.0 is soft law. No binding response yet.
g.text: Viasat cyberattack (2022): attributions only; Tallinn 2.0 is soft law

svg.text: Hexagon: capability milestone. Circle: treaty. Square: resolution or body finding (non-binding). Triangle: unilateral pledge. Open ring: no binding rule yet. Chronology only: a pair shows which came first, not

Source: Secure World Foundation, Global Counterspace Capabilities: An Open Source Assessment (9th ed., Apr. 2026) and the primary sources cited in the ledger. Data as of SWF 9th ed. (Apr. 2026). Companion to
Space Security Law: Governance Beyond the Atmosphere.
